description:
Use this when the user asks how one game's card market as a whole is doing, or
    for the TickerMint index (for example the TickerMint Pokemon 100). Returns the index
    level with its date, its 1-day, 7-day, 30-day and year-to-date change in percent, its
    all-time high, the largest constituents, the latest dated facts from the TickerMint
    wire, and a citation line. The index is an equal-weighted average of the raw TCGplayer
    market prices of the game's priciest singles that trade, rebalanced monthly, base
    1,000. Past prices only; not a forecast.
